Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

constructor.details: Prevents implementation contract from being initialized.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

processPayment(address).details: Takes payment and deposits as incentive into the ezRVault

params.token: The address of the token being paid

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Only the interfaceId of IPaymentReceiver is supported

params.interfaceId: The interface identifier, as specified in ERC-165

returns._0: bool  True if the contract implements `interfaceId` and false otherwise

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

ezRVault.details: address of flow vault where ERC20 will be deposited - underlying token is the asset that will be processed

processPayment(address).notice: Handles the payment of an ERC20 amount

supportsInterface(bytes4).notice: Checks whether the contract supports the given interface
